en.title: The Breath of Verdant Peaks and the Memories of Iron
en.premise: As a botanist, I travel to a remote mountain village to complete the unfinished flora survey left behind by my grandfather, who passed away ten years ago. There, I encounter an old steam locomotive, moss-covered and abandoned in the depths of the forest, and a lonely old man who secretly continues to guard it. Amidst the contrast between the inorganic nature of iron and the primeval forest attempting to swallow it, I find myself quietly contemplating life, death, and the slow weathering of memory.

zh.title: 翠岭之息与钢铁之忆
zh.premise: 作为一名植物学家，为了完成去世十年的祖父留下的未完成植物志调查，我来到了一个偏远的深山村落。在那里，我遇见了一辆被遗弃在森林深处、布满青苔的旧蒸汽机车，以及一位默默守护着它的孤独老人。在冰冷的钢铁与试图将其吞噬的原生林之间的对比中，我静静地思考着生与死，以及记忆的风化。
